capabilities: Browse web pages inside the Obsidian sidebar
Save sites as bookmarks organized in folders
Reorder bookmarks and folders by drag-and-drop
Intercept external link clicks in notes to open them in the built-in browser
Persist bookmarks, folders, and browser preferences in the vault
disambiguation: Not just a bookmark list; it embeds a working web browser in the sidebar, with bookmarks as one part of it.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; only manual installation steps are documented, with English and Chinese versions of the same text.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open and browse web pages or keep site bookmarks inside the sidebar, so external links send you out of the app.
summary: Sidebar web browser that lets you browse websites and manage bookmarks in folders without leaving the vault.
